tool_args.rationale: The observed monotone-concave response reaches s_grad=2.44, close to the documented avalanche onset near 2.50–2.68. A high-gradient probe is the cheapest relevant test of a threshold-driven downturn, which the existing rows cannot resolve.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a smooth siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations are all at the same horizon and stop at s_grad=2.44, just below the documented avalanche threshold range; they cannot identify whether the response turns down above threshold.
This targets the memory ODE family and needs more trajectory data; current evidence instead directly approaches the documented high-gradient threshold.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not discriminate the relevant mechanisms.
